meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Balewadi | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: JEE coaching for Balewadi students at our Wakad branch, a short drive north across the river. Faculty from Kota, {{fact:batch.days}}.

intro: Students in Balewadi are closest to our Wakad branch, about {{commute:balewadi#km}} km north across the river.

body.text: From Balewadi Gaon Road, turn onto Pimple Nilakh Road and go over the Babasaheb Ambedkar Bridge. On the far side, the New DP Road leads to Wakad.

sections.heading: Sport and study in Balewadi

body.text: Balewadi is home to the Shree Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex, which hosted the National Games in 1994 and the Commonwealth Youth Games in 2008.

body: Classes run {{fact:batch.days}} from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}. If your child trains in a sport, plan practice around that window, and the two can sit side by side.

body.text: Two years from Class 11, or one year in Class 12. Either way, a batch has no more than {{fact:batch.size}} students.

questions.q: How far is the Wakad branch from Balewadi?
Is the head office in New Sangvi closer?
questions.a: No. From Balewadi, New Sangvi is farther than Wakad.
